result.brief: 提出统一生成式视频编解码器，共享分层潜码并支持双向与自回归扩散解码，兼顾高质量重建与低延迟流式解码。
result.reason: Unified generative video codec with shared hierarchical latent codec, AR/BI diffusion decoders and distillation; contributes video latent representation and generative video modeling relevant to world_model and video generation.
